beats.event: Sentient Stone left over from Nüwa mending heaven longs for the red dust
A Taoist and a Buddhist monk carry the Stone into the mortal world
Reborn as Jia Baoyu, heir apparent of the Rongguo House
Born with a luminescent jade in his mouth
Strict father Jia Zheng disapproves of his unorthodox reading
A Jia daughter is made Imperial Consort; family prestige peaks
The Daguanyuan garden is built to receive the Imperial Consort's visit
Forms a special poetic bond with his sickly cousin Lin Daiyu
Predestined match with cousin Xue Baochai shadows the household
Long garden days of poetry, music, and cousinly society
Daiyu's fragile health deteriorates as the family strains
Political pressure and mismanagement erode the family fortunes
Tricked into marrying Baochai via a veiled bride substitution
Daiyu dies grieving; the marriage to Baochai is emotionally empty
Government seizes Jia assets; the household collapses in disgrace
Xifeng's loan-shark schemes accelerate the downfall
Baoyu passes the imperial examination before vanishing
Renounces the world and becomes a monk; the Stone returns to origin
